definitions.short: Asa , the name of a king and of a Levite
definitions.full: H609. Asa אָסָא proper name, masculine (perhaps healer ) king of Judah, son of Abijam and father of Jehoshaphat 1Kin 15:8-9 , 11 24 t. 1Kings 15..16.22; 1Chr 3:10 ; 9:16 ; 2Chron 13:23 28t. 14-21; Jer 41:9 . **Perhaps apocopatic theophoric name, compare רְפָאֵל . II. אסה (compare Arabic be sorrowful, distressed).
